name: Signature Shiny

components.expression: a serene, warm smile, eyes soft with compassion.
components.effects: Soft rays of {{MAGIC}} radiant light filter down around her, faint motes of golden light drifting like dust in sunlight. A fine prismatic glitter and a gilded, holographic shimmer play across the metal, the fabric and the magic, every glow edged with a rainbow sheen.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Lumira, visible beyond the hall's high windows, an Elder Dragon of radiant rose-gold and radiant-gold scales, wreathed in soft solar glow, wings like panes of stained light edged in polished white gold

notes: SHINY variant of the Signature: same scene and pose in a prismatic, gilded colourway with a holographic glitter sheen. Convention: <slug>-scene-signature-shiny.
